test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. needs to be

B. the shelf in

C. a piece of wood

D. the kitchen

E. need to buy

F. replaced, so I will
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **BDAFEC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "the shelf in the kitchen," which is correctly indicated by **part (BD).**** **
 
• Following this, "needs to be replaced, so I will" **(AF)** logically explains what is required. 
 
• Ending with**,** "need to buy a piece of wood" **(EC) **completes the sentence by indicating the planned action.

Therefore, the correct answer is BDAFEC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (BEFCAD):** This option incorrectly starts with "the shelf in ," making the sentence incomplete and awkward.
 
• Option 2 (ACDBFE): This option begins with "needs to be" creates a fragmented sentence with incorrect sequencing of actions.
 
• **Option 3 (DEBACF):** This option begins with "the kitchen" and misses the subject's logical placement.
